notes.title: Dreaming... Now, Then
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to conform to strict quality control standards I have established for the full game

Menu / Loading screen
[list]
[*] Added intro cutscene
[*] Improved lighting
[/list]Death screen
[list]
[*] Improved writing
[/list]Proving Grounds
[list]
[*] Overhauled lighting with improved sky texture
[*] Added more geological details
[*] Added another scouting beacon
[*] Improved rain VFX
[/list]Encyclopedia
[list]
[*] New entry unlocked when all beacons are reached
[*] All entries have been completely re-written, most with entirely new direction
[/list]Entry saves have remained intact so you may re-read them all without re-discovery
Player
[list]
[*] Added Adam & Eve (they are asleep)
[*] Added ability to step on creatures
[/list]Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed localization bug where encyclopedia 3D previews did not read meshData in some regions
[*] Fixed music resetting if pausing and unpausing too quickly
[*] Fixed rare bug which sometimes didn't unlock the mouse when looking down
[/list]I have also updated the Demo store page copy and screenshots

Here is a before and after comparison of the Proving Grounds lighting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43625881/a4382aa01693b3dc78c5a24daea7101e0954b3f4.png[/img]
